C3 · THE ADMIN WEEK
The actual work you never see: attorney filings, a storage
unit, receipt reconciliation, leases, rent, utilities.
Captions are machine-generated. Read them before you ship.

DO NOT CUT THIS UNTIL SHE HAS SAID YES
Shavit captioned it “VP of administration” and did not name
her. She is filmed candidly and may not know this is for
Instagram. Get an explicit yes, and ask name or title only.

BUILD NOTES
Title card idea over the first beat:
“What a week looks like from the office.”
No music bed over the first three seconds. Needs end card.
